summary: The shot mostly holds as a flat look, but the head and torso snap around 35.46 to 35.53, and there is a smaller body shift over the first frames after the cut.

faults.what: From 35.43 to 35.53 the head drops and tilts hard over about three frames. The torso and collar shift down, and the neck looks stretched and long at 35.46-35.49. It reads as a snap, not a move with anticipation and settle.
faults.fix: Smooth or retime the head and spine keys across 35.40-35.55 and add an ease into the tilt. Shorten the neck stretch.

faults.what: After the cut, the body keeps shifting over frames 3 to 6 (34.03-34.20). The collar rises, the shoulders widen and the arm swings into frame. The shot is not settled on its first frames.
faults.fix: Start the shot on the settled pose, or trim the first 5 frames of the move.
